description: Set up monitoring for a list of domains (items) and get updates sent to your webhook_url. POST /v1/watch. $0.30 USDC on Base per call. Covers up to 25 domains for 30 days, each re-checked about once a day, with HMAC-signed webhook alerts. Use it when you want ongoing alerts; for a one-time check, call the matching single-check tool instead. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: orioncmd_watch
title: OrionCMD Checks: POST /v1/watch
